name: Four Seasons Fort Lauderdale
insider_take: This sleek oceanfront tower redefines luxury on Fort Lauderdale Beach, where pristine coastline meets sophisticated urban energy.
whats_special: The Four Seasons Fort Lauderdale stands as the tallest residential building on the beach, featuring a stunning rooftop pool deck on the 7th floor with panoramic Atlantic views. The hotel sits directly on the famous Fort Lauderdale Beach Boulevard, known as the "Venice of America" for its intricate canal system with over 300 miles of navigable waterways.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at the spa during sunset hours – the floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking ocean views that transform your massage into a truly transcendent experience.
dont_miss: The nearby Las Olas Boulevard, just minutes away, offers world-class shopping and dining. Time your visit during turtle nesting season (May-October) when loggerhead and leatherback turtles nest directly on the beach in front of the hotel – guided moonlight walks are available through local conservation groups.
pros: Exceptional oceanfront location with direct beach access
Impeccable Four Seasons service and hospitality
Luxurious accommodations with stunning ocean views
cons: Urban beach setting with nearby development
